lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 13-14 distinct, high-contrast vertical white lines are visible. other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes. Two distinct white throat/neck patches. High-contrast white 'sock' markings on all four lower limbs above the hooves.
